text_block_list.text:
Huh? No... it's not that. I was just 
getting a little nervous, that's all...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Still... I'm okay now. Talking with you 
like this, Onii-sama, makes me feel 
relieved...

closely, Onii-sama...!
